method: Freeze root translation when any input position is available; freeze local rotations whose strict descendants include an available joint; apply remaining learned residual via FK
reason: First reference-preserving observation-only control improves occlusion but degrades visible joints
scope: Exploratory posthoc evaluation of all four fixed1000-step models; no new training, no GT in guard; same exact cases
thresholds: Report same5% occluded,2% extra scene/prior,5mm visible,10% foot-velocity gates, without reclassifying registered raw trial
guarantee: Input-available JOINT POSITIONS invariant to2e-6m; not a visible-surface or orientation guarantee
